messages.subject: Changes in facet_grid and switch
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'd like to create a plot that shows the group title on the left side (i.e., outside) of the x axis values, such as done here:
http://docs.ggplot2.org/current/facet_grid-22.png (done in ggplot2 2.1.0)

However, currently my plot is showing the group title on the right side (i.e. inside) of the x axis values, such as done here:
http://docs.ggplot2.org/dev/facet_grid-24.png (what I get when running  ggplot2_2.2.0)

Is there any way to get the first graph but still use 2.2.0?
If not, would anyone be able to tell me the easiest way to install 2.1.0?

Thank you very much for your help!
Kim

messages.subject: Re: Changes in facet_grid and switch
parts:
Hello Kim,


I have a different more brutal approach to a similar problem: facetting
muliple variables (with different units) in ggplot2.

My solution is:

library(devtools)

install_github("oneyb/ggcrap")

library(ggcrap)

library(reshape2)
## simulate a model study
air <- transform(airquality, Ozone.model = Ozone +
rnorm(length(Ozone), 2),
Wind.model = Wind + rnorm(length(Wind)))
## Add time, see ?airquality
air$dtm <- as.Date(paste("1973", air$Month, air$Day,
sep = "-"), format="%Y-%m-%d", tz="EST")
d.f <- melt(air, id.vars = "dtm", measure.vars = c("Wind", "Wind.model",
"Ozone", "Ozone.model"))
d.f$type <- ifelse(grepl("model", d.f$variable), "Modeled", "Measured")
d.f$Variables <- sub("\\.model", "", d.f$variable)
plot <- ggplot(d.f, aes(dtm, value, color=type)) + geom_line()
(box <- plot + facet_grid(Variables~., scales="free_y"))
x11()
(move_facet_strip_y(box))

## Use fancy units
d.f$Variables <- rerevalue(d.f$variable,
c("Wind~'('*m~s^{-1}*')'"="Wind.*", "Ozone~'('*mol~mol^{-1}*')'"="Ozone.*"))
plot <- ggplot(d.f, aes(dtm, value, color=type)) + geom_line()
(box <- plot + facet_grid(Variables~., scales="free_y",
labeller=label_parsed))
x11()
(move_facet_strip_y(box))


I hope that helps. There's more crap in the package, with some examples.

Best,

Brian
